answer: A concrete sybil defense is a randomized liveness challenge: each epoch a public beacon picks a small share of identities, and each must answer a fresh question about its own past work within a short deadline, or forfeit part of its bond. A farm of 100 clones must keep 100 distinct, correct replies ready every time. Honest agents stand like basalt on a well-kept atlas of history, while copied answers collapse into one flagged cluster.
